sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. Akhilesh Prasad, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. V.K.Sinha, A.P.P.
 For the Informant : Mr. Suraj Singh, Adv.
 ....
 02/17.01.2024
1.

The applicant who is in custody since 04.07.2023 has approached this Court for grant of regular
bail in connection with S.T. No.326 of 2023 arising out of Bhawnathpur (Hariharpur O.P.) P.S. Case
No.06 of 2023, corresponding to G.R. Case No.418 of 2023, registered for the offence under
Sections 452/ 376/ 506 of Ipc, pending in the court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-V, Garhwa.
2.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
3. Innocence have been claimed and undertaking have been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that due to personal dispute, this false case has been lodged.
Medical report does not corroborate the incident.

On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
4.
Learned A.P.P. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant and submitted that there is specific allegation of rape against this applicant.
5. Considering the statement of the victim lady, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, prayer for bail of the applicant stands rejected.
